_: The photograph at the head of the sheet of each country nobody has written of (src/screens/FlagProfile.tsx): one chosen by eye for each, among what Wikidata shows the country is known by and what Commons has of what it is best known by (scripts/data/outside.mjs, source heads, and scripts/data/heads-asked.txt). By the id of the country: the title of the file in Wikimedia Commons (file), what is seen in it in the two languages of the game (es, en) and, where the middle of the picture is not what should stay in sight when its top and bottom are cut off, which point should, in hundredths of its width and of its height (focus). Who made each and on what terms it is given usually comes from Commons via the source photos; where its credit must be shortened or specified as the author requires, it is written here (by). The site the author requests for credit, when there is one, is linked here as byUrl (https only). A country whose sheet is written by hand (scripts/data/profiles) names its own photographs, and what is said of it here is not used. Written by hand: no program writes this file. One country to a line, the ids in order.
